normalization.wordTokenization: ASCII [a-z0-9] runs after normalization; non-ASCII glyphs, including Japanese, are excluded from WER.
normalization.characterComparison: CER compares normalized Unicode text, retaining non-Latin letters and numbers as supporting evidence.

rankingPolicy: grouped full metric rankings; local and third-party service providers are not ranked against each other
notes: WER tokenizes normalized text as ASCII [a-z0-9] runs and excludes non-ASCII glyphs, including Japanese. The WER-derived headline quality score does not measure complete Japanese or other non-Latin OCR accuracy.
CER retains normalized Unicode letters and numbers as supporting evidence. Review CER and the source images when assessing non-Latin extraction quality.

Each declared page must succeed before a provider receives a full-document score. Partial outputs remain private and unscored in full-document rankings.
Reference provenance: the existing archived multi-provider consensus is reused byte for byte; it is not independent publisher gold.

Each provider received the same pinned original PNG/JPEG or the declared rendered-PNG baseline variant. Reference text, table cells, manuscript deletions and graph/layout annotations were never sent to providers. Text recognition is scored separately from unavailable cell, branch and page-geometry accuracy.

Accounted prices include settled retry usage and retained uncertain reservations; they are not invoice-reconciled charges. Any held or conservative component makes the price a conservative upper bound.
Supplemental evaluation-diagnostics.json retains punctuation/case/formatting diagnostics separately from lexical-normalized headline WER.

referenceProvenance.description: Existing archived multi-provider consensus reused byte for byte; this is not independently supplied publisher gold.
referenceProvenance.serializationPolicy: Existing agent-authored multi-provider consensus copied byte-for-byte; original JPEG bytes reused as a distinct run without modifying historical results.

evaluation.referenceTextScope: Existing archived multi-provider consensus; not independent publisher gold.
evaluation.structureAccuracyUnavailableReason: Text-only OCR does not establish handwriting placement, drawing geometry or spatial association.
evaluation.lexicalMetricLimitation: Headline WER/CER use the existing case-insensitive lexical normalization and declared reference order. Reading-order or serialization differences can increase edit distance; these scores do not measure layout or exact glyph/punctuation fidelity.
evaluation.fidelityMetricLimitation: Literal numeric, punctuation and whitespace comparisons are representation-fidelity diagnostics. TSV tabs, span-continuation blanks, Markdown wrappers and source case conventions can differ without establishing a recognition error.

coverage.qualityCoverage: Full-document headline scores require all pages. Failed and incomplete models have no invented quality score; successful page evidence remains private.
